messages.author: 1a55752c1a45d8fc
messages.subject: plotDensity - can we add legends?
parts:
Hi Group,

I'm using plotDensity() for a matrix 27000xN (N=5) and I want to be
able to label the individual density plots so I know which of the N
corresponds to the plot. I have not been successful with legends().
I would like the legends in the top right corner. Any suggestions
would be helpful.

Thank you.
Houtan N.
USC, Epigenome Center

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] plotDensity - can we add legends?
parts:
Hi Houtan.

Do this example do what you need?

y <- matrix( rnorm(2000*5), nc=5 )
colnames(y) <- paste("sample",1:5,sep="")

plotDensity(y, col=1:5, lwd=4)
legend("topright",colnames(y),col=1:5,lwd=4)

Cheers,
Mark
